mapper.sql: ut_competitors.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ut_competitor_business_types WHERE id IN ( SELECT ut_competitor_business_type_id FROM ut_competitor_business_details WHERE ut_competitor_business_details.is_active = 1 AND ut_competitor_id = ut_competitors.id )) AS businessTypes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ut_competitor_type_of_products WHERE id IN ( SELECT ut_competitor_type_of_product_id FROM ut_competitor_main_products WHERE ut_competitor_main_products.is_active = 1 AND ut_competitor_id = ut_competitors.id )) AS mainProducts, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM ut_competitor_type_of_products WHERE id IN ( SELECT ut_competitor_type_of_product_id FROM ut_competitor_products WHERE ut_competitor_products.is_active = 1 AND ut_competitor_id = ut_competitors.id )) AS productTypes, ut_competitors.`name` AS `name`, ut_competitors.address AS address, ut_competitors.description AS description, ut_competitors.number_customer AS numberOfCustomer, ut_competitors.sales_revenue AS estimateSalesRevenue, ut_competitors.is_close AS isClose

ut_competitors.id AS id, ut_competitor_priority_id AS priorityId, ut_competitor_priorities.name AS priorityName, ut_competitor_statu_id AS statusId, ut_competitor_status.name AS statusName, ut_competitor_stage_id AS stageId, ut_competitor_stages.name AS stageName, ut_competitor_employee_id AS employeeAmountId, ut_competitor_employees.name AS employeeAmountName, ut_competitors.`name` AS `name`, ut_competitors.address AS address, ut_competitors.partner AS partner, ut_competitors.description AS description, ut_competitors.number_customer AS numberOfCustomer, ut_competitors.contact AS contact, ut_competitors.employee_info AS employeeInfo, ut_competitors.sales_revenue AS estimateSalesRevenue, ut_competitors.is_close AS isClose

FROM ut_competitors LEFT JOIN ut_competitor_priorities ON ut_competitor_priorities.id = ut_competitors.ut_competitor_priority_id LEFT JOIN ut_competitor_status ON ut_competitor_status.id = ut_competitors.ut_competitor_statu_id LEFT JOIN ut_competitor_stages ON ut_competitor_stages.id = ut_competitors.ut_competitor_stage_id LEFT JOIN ut_competitor_employees ON ut_competitor_employees.id = ut_competitors.ut_competitor_employee_id

WHERE ut_competitors.is_active = 1
AND ut_competitors.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ut_competitors ( ut_competitor_priority_id, ut_competitor_statu_id, ut_competitor_stage_id, ut_competitor_employee_id, partner, `name`, address, description, contact, employee_info, number_customer, sales_revenue, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{competitor.priorityId}, #{competitor.statusId}, #{competitor.stageId}, #{competitor.employeeAmountId}, #{competitor.partner}, #{competitor.name}, #{competitor.address}, #{competitor.description}, #{competitor.contact}, #{competitor.employeeInfo}, #{competitor.numberOfCustomer}, #{competitor.salesRevenue}, NOW(), #{competitor.createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ut_competitors SET ut_competitor_priority_id = #{competitor.priorityId}, ut_competitor_statu_id = #{competitor.statusId}, ut_competitor_stage_id = #{competitor.stageId}, ut_competitor_employee_id = #{competitor.employeeAmountId}, partner = #{competitor.partner}, `name` = #{competitor.name}, address = #{competitor.address}, description = #{competitor.description}, contact = #{competitor.contact}, employee_info = #{competitor.employeeInfo}, number_customer = #{competitor.numberOfCustomer}, sales_revenue = #{competitor.salesRevenue}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{competitor.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{competitor.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE ut_competitors SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
